what: the contact-role arm (CR): what it cost, what it won, and why only one clip ships
arm: CR -- contact_role_palm and contact_consistency reward terms, weights 2.0 and 1.0

pre_registered_expansion_bar.rule: worth its 30-clip run only if >=4 of the 6 actionable clips win on kit AUC AND the mean rises
pre_registered_expansion_bar.consequence: NOT expanded to 30 clips. The arm stops here.

per_clip_adoption.rule: the registered input-only rule; see results/cr_adoption.json
per_clip_adoption.note: e05 gained +0.132 kit AUC but drifted from the input (14.95 -> 19.51 cm), so the rule keeps the incumbent. The rule costs us that gain and is applied anyway.

the_one_clip.why_it_matters: the input-only rule, reading no truth, selected the clip that is also the right choice on truth: -52.21 cm MPPE and +0.135 AUC. The arm's one win is simultaneously evidence for the paper's claim that selection does not need ground truth.
